Social items are a manual checklist; ticking them does not publish on social media. Reviewed website publications and Postcards appear here automatically with a document or envelope icon. Manage those dates and approvals in Write or Postcards.

Import your content plan

Select your original HTML overview or its calendar JSON export. Preview it first, then save it to your private calendar. Existing posts and their checkmarks will be preserved.

Maximum 50 posts per import, 2 MB per file. Your plan is never added to public website files.

Your reminders

Unscheduled and unpublished posts are highlighted here from the day before their post date. Mark a post as scheduled or published to clear its reminder.

Automatic checks can be delayed; this is not an exact-time alarm. You can turn off a reminder for an individual post below.

Email reminder status will load after sign-in.

Your private calendar will load after sign-in.

Select an item to open its details. Drag a social post, task or appointment to another day, or open it and choose Move date. Review the new date before saving; its Amsterdam time stays the same. Website and Postcard schedules open in their own editor. Orange means an item needs attention.
